user.title: Set up trip recording
user.description: Choose the sensors of your vehicle. Trips are detected from the D+ signal and exported to the media folder.

data_description.dplus_entity: Sensor or binary sensor that is on while the engine runs.
data_description.dplus_on_value: State that means "on", for example ON. Upper and lower case do not matter.
data_description.tracker_entity: Device tracker with the vehicle position. It also identifies the vehicle.
data_description.speed_entity: Sensor with the speed in km/h.
data_description.altitude_entity: Optional sensor with the altitude in metres.
data_description.output_dir: Folder inside the local media folder (/media) where exports are stored.

reconfigure.title: Change data sources
reconfigure.description: Change the sensors or the output folder. Existing exports stay where they are.

data_description.dplus_entity: Sensor or binary sensor that is on while the engine runs.
data_description.dplus_on_value: State that means "on", for example ON. Upper and lower case do not matter.
data_description.tracker_entity: Device tracker with the vehicle position. It also identifies the vehicle.
data_description.speed_entity: Sensor with the speed in km/h.
data_description.altitude_entity: Optional sensor with the altitude in metres.
data_description.output_dir: Folder inside the local media folder (/media) where exports are stored.

error.invalid_output_dir: Enter a folder inside the media folder, without "..".

abort.already_configured: This position tracker is already set up.

data_description.end_delay: How long D+ must stay off before the trip ends.
data_description.merge_window: How long after its end a trip can still continue, for example after a long wait at the port. 0 turns merging off.
data_description.min_movement: A trip that never got further than this from its start is ignored.

data_description.title_format: What the title of an automatically detected trip contains.
data_description.place_names: Sends the start and end position to OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) to name the places. Without it, the title only contains the date.
data_description.scale: Size factor for all images. Whole numbers fit the map tiles best.
data_description.margin: Minutes shown before departure and after arrival in the speed chart.

data_description.standstill_speed: Below this speed the vehicle counts as standing still.
data_description.max_accuracy: Positions with a larger GPS inaccuracy are dropped.
data_description.min_point_distance: Closer points are thinned out for the map and GPX.
data_description.elevation_hysteresis: Altitude changes smaller than this do not count towards the elevation gain.
